title: Adversarial Causal Tuning (ACT) / TCS
summary: Research codebase for the paper 'Adversarial Causal Tuning for Realistic Time-series Generation', which introduces a modular pipeline (TCS) for simulating realistic time-series data with time-lagged causal graphs and an AutoML scheme for selecting simulation configurations. Its baseline comparison notebook and simulation_baselines.py fit and sample SDV's PARSynthesizer (via sdv.sequential) as a non-causal sequential synthesizer baseline against which TCS is evaluated.
evidence: src/simulation/simulation_baselines.py:78-84 shows metadata = Metadata.detect_from_dataframe(...); synthesizer = PARSynthesizer(metadata); synthesizer.fit(...); synthesizer.sample(...) used to produce a 'CPAR' baseline compared against TCS in exp_3_vs_baselines.ipynb ('baseline comparisons between TCS, CausalTime and non-causal simulators (CPAR, TVAE)')
